title: Base change of a discrete finite type scheme to a field extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension, and let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] whose underlying topological space is discrete. Let $X_K=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ be the base change [def-pc-base-change]. Then $X_K$ is locally Artinian (for every affine open $U\subseteq X_K$ the ring $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_{X_K})$ is Artinian); in particular the underlying space of $X_K$ is discrete and $\dim X_K\le0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].
